chosen.label: MarketEvent
chosen.definition: An event related to financial markets, such as stock price changes or market trends.
chosen.justification: No schema.org class for market events; minting with Event as parent.

candidates.label: DeliveryEvent
candidates.comment: An event representing the delivery of an item, typically a product or package. Also called Shipping event, package delivery, consignment event. Examples: A package arriving at its destination, a food delivery being completed, a furniture delivery appointment. Distinct from Order, which is the request for items, not the delivery itself.

candidates.label: BusinessEvent
candidates.comment: A BusinessEvent is an Event related to commercial activities, such as conferences, trade shows, or corporate meetings. Also called corporate event, professional gathering, industry event. Examples: a sales conference, a product launch event, an annual shareholder meeting. Distinct from SocialEvent, which is for personal or recreational gatherings.

candidates.label: SaleEvent
candidates.comment: An event where goods or services are offered for sale, often at reduced prices. Also called sales promotion, discount event, clearance sale, special offer. Examples: a Black Friday sale, an annual warehouse clearance, a seasonal clothing sale, a car dealership's sales event.

candidates.label: SportsEvent
candidates.comment: An event involving athletic competition or display. Also called athletic contest, game, match, sporting competition. Examples: a football game, an Olympic event, a marathon race, a tennis tournament.

candidates.label: ComedyEvent
candidates.comment: An event featuring comedic performances or content. Also called stand-up show, humor performance, comedy festival. Examples: A stand-up comedy show, a sketch comedy performance, a comedy festival, an improv night. Distinct from Event, which is a general occurrence.

chosen.label: ProductLaunch
chosen.definition: An event where a new product is introduced to the public.
chosen.justification: No schema.org class for product launches; minting with Event as parent.

candidates.label: UserPlusOnes
candidates.comment: An outdated type representing a user's interaction of giving a "+1" endorsement, typically on Google+ or similar platforms. Also called user endorsement, +1, social recommendation. Examples: a user giving a +1 to a web page, endorsing a business, recommending content.

candidates.label: UserInteraction
candidates.comment: An outdated general type representing any interaction a user has with a web page or content. Also called user activity, user engagement, web interaction. Examples: a user clicking a link, submitting a form, scrolling a page.

candidates.label: Hackathon
candidates.comment: A Hackathon is an event where participants collaboratively engage in intensive computer programming or design over a short period. Also called coding sprint, dev challenge, programming marathon. Examples: university hackathon, corporate innovation sprint, open-source code jam.

candidates.label: UserPageVisits
candidates.comment: An outdated type representing a user's interaction of visiting a web page. Also called page view, web visit, browsing activity. Examples: a user navigating to a product page, visiting a news article, browsing a website.

chosen.label: EarningsRelease
chosen.definition: An event where a company publicly announces its financial results.
chosen.justification: No schema.org class for earnings releases; minting with Event as parent.

candidates.label: UserDownloads
candidates.comment: An outdated type representing a user's interaction of downloading content. Also called user download, content download, file retrieval. Examples: a user downloading a software update, downloading an e-book, saving an image from a website.

candidates.label: OnDemandEvent
candidates.comment: An OnDemandEvent, as a PublicationEvent, is a publication event where a program is available on-demand. Also called catch-up TV, podcast release, streaming event. Examples: a TV show episode available for streaming after broadcast, a podcast episode release, a movie available for rent online. Distinct from BroadcastEvent, which is a live or scheduled transmission.

candidates.label: CourseInstance
candidates.comment: A CourseInstance is a specific offering of an educational course, distinguished by its particular time, location, medium, or target student group. Also called course section, class session, course offering, specific class. Examples: "Fall 2023 Introduction to Python (Online)," "Spring 2024 Art History 101 (Campus A, Section B)," "Summer Intensive Yoga Teacher Training." Distinct from Course, which is the general description of the educational content.

candidates.label: PublicationEvent
candidates.comment: A PublicationEvent is an Event corresponding to the publication of a CreativeWork, regardless of its type or delivery medium. Also called release event, publishing event. Examples: the release of a new book, the broadcast of a TV show, the online publication of an article, the launch of a new album.

chosen.label: LeadershipChange
chosen.definition: An event where there is a change in the leadership of an organization.
chosen.justification: No schema.org class for leadership changes; minting with Event as parent.
